title: Optional: dynamic retrieval D with masked keys on FINAL (cap 2,000 Jev)
description:
## Purpose

Optionally measure dynamic retrieval (D) on bios with pronoun-masked retrieval keys.

## Scope

One variant (embedding or BM25, chosen by the free masked kNN proxy) on FINAL + twins; skip if the proxy shows no gain or the ledger has no room.

## Cost cap

Hard cap 2,000 Jev requests (about $0.8-1.2), and only if the cumulative ledger stays at most 15,000; otherwise owner approval first.

## Definition of done

D row with twin metrics added to the final summary, or a comment saying why it was skipped.

## Links

[UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md) (Addendum 3)
